component: EWS sync size request, optional header metadata and synthetic tests

quotes.text: "the correct message sizes should have been reported"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical EWS sync change requests item:Size and stores a present value only if it fits the database u32 field. Overflow is logged instead of assigning a truncated size. A parsed message supplies its raw-message length through the same optional-size role. Synthetic tests compare generated message text lengths to reported or stored messageSize; they do not test missing values, overflow or Unicode byte accounting. Current stored-size checks explicitly exclude Graph. Server messageSize and local offlineMessageSize must stay distinct. No synchronization or test ran.
title: EWS synchronization records server-reported size without requiring full-body download
